title: Link directly to referenced settings

statement.en: When directing someone to a setting, provide a direct link or button.
statement.ja: settingへ案内するときdirect linkまたはbuttonを提供する。

conditions: Do not rely on prose that describes the setting's location.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Writing experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるWritingの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

manual: Does the design satisfy “When directing someone to a setting, provide a direct link or button.” in the documented Writing context?

anti_patterns: Ignoring this guidance in a context where the source section applies.
positive_examples: A design review records how the implementation satisfies this rule and any source-scoped exception.
